threads.label: The treasure map
threads.text: It led you to Brandonsford, but you don't recognize any of its marked locations. Where they are, and which one holds the treasure, is still unknown.

threads.label: The dragon
threads.text: Eric the Reeve offers a thousand gold for its body, dragged into town. Its whereabouts are unknown. Eric says woodsman George, who lost an arm to it, may visit the Clumsy Fox tonight.

threads.label: The Clurichen
threads.text: Reginald the Frog warns that this trickster comes into town from the riverbanks every night.

threads.label: Lady Hilda's offer
threads.text: She will join your dragon hunt if you pay her. Sir Phidipaldi told her you would return.

threads.label: The missing shipments
threads.text: Bentley says his tavern's shipment never arrived, and the loss is hurting all of Brandonsford. Why shipments have stopped coming is still unknown.

threads.label: Drop Dead Ned
threads.text: He offers to hire on with his killer wasp for a hundred gold a week, as long as he gets to kill people. Dr. Uriah said he'd think about it.

threads.label: Quinn's empty bar
threads.text: Someone or something empties the Golden Egg's stock every night. Quinn, its owner, offers a hundred gold for catching the culprit, and Sir Phidipaldi agreed to help.

threads.label: Dunk and Farmer Gill
threads.text: Gill offered Dunk a mule and told how Sir Brandon once slew a dragon.

closing: Sir Phidipaldi and Quinn are at the Golden Egg, about to stage a fake ale shipment. They'll fill Quinn's bottles with water, and Sir Phidipaldi will make a big show of delivering them. Wayman and Dr. Uriah are at the Clumsy Fox. Dunk is drinking on Farmer Gill's porch.
